name: ClickSyncr for Beehiiv – Contact Form 7 Integration
author: ClickSyncr

sections.description:
ClickSyncr for Beehiiv connects your Contact Form 7 forms to Beehiiv, so every form submission becomes a subscriber on the Beehiiv publication you choose — automatically, with no code.

Stop copying and pasting emails between your website and your newsletter. Map your form fields to Beehiiv once, and ClickSyncr keeps your audience growing on autopilot every time someone fills out a form.

“Beehiiv” is a trademark of beehiiv, Inc. This plugin is an independent integration and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by beehiiv, Inc.

Why you’ll love it

  • Set up in minutes — paste your Beehiiv API key and you’re connected. No developers, no code.
  • Your publications load automatically — choose which Beehiiv publication new subscribers join, right inside the form editor.
  • Map the fields that matter — send the email address and any Beehiiv custom field straight from your form.
  • No duplicate subscribers — Beehiiv matches by email, so an existing subscriber is updated (and reactivated if needed) instead of duplicated.
  • A setup for every form — each Contact Form 7 form can sync to a different publication with its own field mapping.
  • Lightweight and fast — built to WordPress standards, so it never slows your site down.
  • You stay in control — you decide exactly what data is sent, and to which publication.

Learn more about the Contact Form 7 to Beehiiv integration.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Beehiiv tab.
  3. Paste your Beehiiv API key — your publications and custom fields load instantly.
  4. Choose a publication and map your form fields to Beehiiv fields (email is required).
  5. Save the form. Every submission now syncs to Beehiiv automatically.

What you’ll need

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • Contact Form 7 installed and activated
  • A Beehiiv account with an API key

Getting your Beehiiv API key

  1. Log in to your Beehiiv account.
  2. Go to Settings > Workspace > API.
  3. Create a new API key.
  4. Paste it into the ClickSyncr Beehiiv tab.

Support

Need a hand? Visit clicksyncr.com and we’ll be glad to help.

External service: Beehiiv

This plugin connects to Beehiiv, the newsletter platform, to sync your Contact Form 7 submissions with your Beehiiv account. Requests are sent to the Beehiiv API at api.beehiiv.com.

When data is sent: when you connect your API key, when your publications and custom fields load in the form editor, and when a visitor submits a form you’ve configured with ClickSyncr — at which point their form data (email and any mapped fields) is sent to Beehiiv.

What is sent: your Beehiiv API key (to authenticate), the subscriber’s email address and any fields you choose to map, and the publication you select.

By using this plugin you agree to Beehiiv’s Privacy Policy. You are responsible for complying with applicable data-protection laws (such as GDPR and CCPA) and for obtaining consent from your visitors before their data is collected and sent to Beehiiv.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “ClickSyncr for Beehiiv”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.

After installation

  1. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated.
  2. Edit any Contact Form 7 form and open the ClickSyncr Beehiiv tab.
  3. Follow the on-screen setup. Full guidance is on the ClickSyncr for Beehiiv page.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Beehiiv account?

Yes. You’ll need an active Beehiiv account and an API key to sync your subscribers.

Is Contact Form 7 required?

Yes. ClickSyncr connects Contact Form 7 to Beehiiv, so Contact Form 7 must be installed and activated.

Where do I find my Beehiiv API key?

Log in to Beehiiv, go to Settings > Workspace > API, and create a new API key.

Which fields can I map?

You can map your form fields to your publication’s Beehiiv custom fields. Email is always required and is sent automatically.

Will it create duplicate subscribers?

No. Beehiiv matches by email, so an existing subscriber is updated (and reactivated if previously unsubscribed) rather than duplicated.

Can I use different settings for different forms?

Yes. Every Contact Form 7 form has its own ClickSyncr Beehiiv setup, so each can sync to a different publication.
